request.style: English, male gritty rock voice with backing choir, electric guitar, acoustic guitar, bass, drums, cymbals, somber and tense mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A very large assembly gathered around
Men women and children all in the crowd
Weeping bitterly before the house of God
Confessing our sins as the tears did flow

[Verse]
Shecaniah spoke up from the Elam line
We have been unfaithful to God divine
Yet now there is hope for Israel still
Send away all these women as we will

[Chorus]
Only Jonathan and Jahzeiah opposed this
Meshullam and Shabbethai stood with his
They trembled at the command of our Lord
According to the Law it was recorded

[Verse]
A proclamation went out to Judah and Ben
Gather in Jerusalem within three days
Or forfeit your property and be excluded
The leaders and elders made this decree

[Chorus]
Only Jonathan and Jahzeiah opposed this
Meshullam and Shabbethai stood with his
They trembled at the command of our Lord
According to the Law it was recorded

[Bridge]
On the twentieth of the ninth month we sat
In the open square in the heavy rain
Trembling because of this matter so grave
The weight of the covenant was on us

[Outro]
From the first of the tenth to the first of the first
We finished dealing with all the men
Who had married foreign women in the land
The work of the commission was done
